title: arifOS 555 Challenge Envelope v1
description: One verification protocol for the federation (F13-approved shape 2026-10-18). Fields: claim, evidence, provenance, freshness, contradiction, falsifier, confidence, independent_witness. Verdicts: ACCEPT | REJECT | UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. A claim without a falsifier is REJECTED (CLAIM_WITHOUT_FALSIFIER). Consumers: arif_judge evidence gate, HERMES claim_validate, CHRON prediction mint, FRAME observation handoff, A-FORGE claim gates (adapters in arifosmcp/runtime/challenge_envelope.py).

freshness.description: timestamp of the evidence, not of the claim

contradiction.description: known counter-evidence; null only when none found and searched

falsifier.description: the observation that would make this claim wrong

independent_witness.description: at least one witness whose id != claimant (WITNESS_SELF)
